name: sprint-review-template
description: Remotion template for creating sprint review videos

scripts.render: npx remotion render src/index.ts SprintReview out/sprint-review.mp4 --crf=17
scripts.render:hq: npx remotion render src/index.ts SprintReview out/sprint-review-hq.mp4 --codec=h265 --crf=16
scripts.render:preview: npx remotion render src/index.ts SprintReview out/preview.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=23
